verdict.rationale: SAM.gov's Entity Management API documentation has an OpenAPI Specification File section with a downloadable spec, which delivers the story. The probe's 404s at generic paths like /openapi.json do not contradict this, because the spec is published from the docs page rather than a well-known path. Missing for 10: no hands-on confirmation the spec file downloads and validates, no evidence of OpenAPI specs for the other SAM.gov APIs (Opportunities, Exclusions, Contracts, Federal Hierarchy), and no discoverable well-known spec URL.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: the Entity Management API documentation carries an OpenAPI Specification File section with the downloadable spec.
